fall_2026.description: Initial development, validation, and deployment of the IEI using existing BREATHE-CC participants and simulation data.

components.name: IEI Annotated Bibliography
components.description: Minimum 25 sources annotated with relevance to the Integrated Exposure Index: time-weighted exposure models, indoor/outdoor pollutant integration, spatial interpolation methods.

components.name: IEI Literature Review
components.description: Narrative review of environmental exposure science literature supporting the IEI construct: time-activity patterns, multi-pollutant indices, exposure measurement in existing cohorts.

components.name: IEI Data Analysis Pipeline & GitHub Repository
components.description: Functional, documented IEI construction pipeline: outdoor data integration (TCEQ/EPA), indoor survey scoring, time-weighting algorithm, composite scoring. Version-controlled on GitHub.

components.name: IEI Manuscript Draft
components.description: Initial draft of the IEI methods paper: Introduction and Methods sections. Journal-formatted draft with a clear journal target and list of backup journals.

components.name: Meeting Attendance & Participation
components.description: Consistent attendance per cadence schedule. Prepared agendas, responsiveness to sponsor feedback, documented action items. Effective updates to other committee members.

components.name: Fall Progress Presentation
components.description: Presentation to thesis committee summarizing IEI development, validation results, preliminary outcome association methods, and spring semester plan. Delivered 1-2 weeks before fall final exams begin (Dec 7, 2026).

spring_2027.description: Completion of IEI Methods Manuscript, health outcome analysis pipeline (IEI-asthma regression models, GBTM phenotyping, sensitivity checks on available data), research poster, and public defense.

components.name: Health Outcome Analysis Pipeline Draft
components.description: Draft of code and outputs for IEI-asthma outcome analysis: bivariate and adjusted regression models (Poisson/negative binomial for exacerbations, linear mixed models for C-ACT, GBTM for wheezing phenotypes). Sensitivity checks and subgroup analyses. Reproducible, documented pipeline designed for rerunning on finalized BREATHE-CC cohort.

components.name: IEI Manuscript Finalization (Final Thesis Draft)
components.description: Journal-ready IEI methods manuscript formatted per target journal guidelines. Incorporates all committee feedback and analysis results. Submitted as final version to committee.

components.name: Final Health Outcome Analysis Pipeline
components.description: Final analysis pipeline product incorporating feedback and suggested revisions by committee members. Open-access GitHub Repository with final code, sample outputs, and clearly documented rationale behind all analyses.

components.name: Research Poster
components.description: Conference-style research poster summarizing IEI development, validation, and preliminary health outcome findings based on available BREATHE-CC data. Presented at the Rollins Honors Summit in April 2027.

components.name: Meeting Attendance & Participation
components.description: Continued adherence to meeting cadence; proactive communication; timely incorporation of feedback.

components.name: Thesis Defense & Final Submission
components.description: Public oral defense including 25-30 min presentation and committee Q&A by the week before spring final exams begin (at the latest). Post-defense revisions and final submission to Rollins Honors Program by May 1st, 2027.
